pages.text: Hop is a green climbing-looking stalk with pale cones. Search the tall-crop biomes in $(l:psychedelicraft:growing/finding_plants)Where to Look$(/l), plains greenhouses, and novice farmer offers.

pages.title: Grow for Beer
pages.text: Plant hop seeds on bright farmland or suitable dirt. Leave room for the stalk above. Break the mature stalk for cones and seeds. Two cones and five wheat make a batch of $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/brewing_examples)beer wort$(/l).
